source: Demo Command Center V5 six-industry productization contract

lanes.name: Products CPG
lanes.promise: Promotion demand, packaging readiness, replenishment, and shelf confidence stay connected.
lanes.validateLive: Validate promotion demand, pack-size readiness, replenishment timing, and shelf availability in one path.
lanes.storyline: Lead with packaged-goods CPG through promotion-to-shelf readiness and prove packaging, replenishment, and shelf confidence.
guardrails: Do not drift into ingredient, batch, lab, dealer, branch, or service-order language.

lanes.name: Food / Beverage CPG Manufacturing
lanes.promise: Ingredient and packaging readiness flow into finished-good availability and customer promise protection.
lanes.validateLive: Validate ingredient readiness, packaging timing, line continuity, and finished-good availability in one path.
lanes.storyline: Lead with food and beverage readiness through ingredient, packaging, line continuity, and finished-good confidence.
guardrails: Do not drift into generic CPG shelf language, branch distribution, industrial assembly, or lab-release proof.

lanes.name: Industrial Equipment Manufacturing
lanes.promise: Component readiness and supplier timing protect assembly confidence and delivery promise.
lanes.validateLive: Validate configured demand, component readiness, assembly timing, and delivery confidence in one equipment path.
lanes.storyline: Lead with industrial equipment through component readiness, supplier timing, assembly confidence, and shipment control.
guardrails: Do not drift into WIP, field service, dealer hardgoods, food batching, or life-sciences release proof.

lanes.name: Life Sciences
lanes.promise: Validation, traceability, lot/release readiness, and controlled fulfillment protect regulated customer commitments.
lanes.validateLive: Validate regulated demand, validation readiness, traceability, serialization, and lot release in one life-sciences path.
lanes.storyline: Lead with Life Sciences through controlled instrument build fulfillment and prove lot readiness, validation control, traceability, and release confidence.
guardrails: Do not drift into food batching, industrial equipment, dealer-channel, or generic distribution language.

lanes.name: Industrial Distribution & Branch Fulfillment
lanes.promise: Branch availability, supplier timing, replenishment control, and fulfillment confidence protect customer promise.
lanes.validateLive: Validate branch availability, supplier timing, replenishment control, and fulfillment confidence in one distribution path.
lanes.storyline: Lead with branch availability, supplier exceptions, transfer-aware replenishment, and realistic promise control.
guardrails: Do not drift into manufacturing, food, field-service, dealer-channel, or lab-release language.

lanes.name: Dealer Hardgoods & Channel Fulfillment
lanes.promise: Product/SKU availability, dealer/channel replenishment, and fulfillment confidence protect channel promise.
lanes.validateLive: Validate product availability, dealer allocation, replenishment timing, and channel fulfillment in one hardgoods path.
lanes.storyline: Lead with dealer/channel hardgoods through product availability, allocation, replenishment timing, and fulfillment confidence.
guardrails: Do not collapse dealer-channel truth into branch distribution, field service, food, or regulated release language.

lanes.name: Apparel & Accessories
lanes.promise: Style, size, color, allocation, replenishment, and channel availability stay connected.
lanes.validateLive: Validate style readiness, size/color availability, allocation, replenishment timing, and channel promise in one apparel path.
lanes.storyline: Lead with apparel and accessories through style/SKU matrix readiness, variant availability, allocation confidence, and collection launch control.
guardrails: Do not collapse apparel and accessories into industrial equipment, generic branch distribution, food batching, or regulated release proof.
